title: onoseris onoseroides
intro: Onoseris onoseroides, commonly known as Onoseris, is a plant species of the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Onoseris include its potential to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties, while its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Onoseris onoseroides include flavonoids, terpenoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
